entries.text: The published results corpus adds its first bundles with captured query plans: TPC-H SF 0.1 on DuckDB and on Polars DataFrame. The Results Explorer shows the plans on each result page and offers the plans file for download.
details: DuckDB plans are estimated EXPLAIN operator trees with fingerprints; Polars plans are optimized lazy plans as text, without fingerprints. Both runs use the qgen default parameters and passed row-count validation on all 22 queries.
